claims.text: Incorrectly-classified actions and objects can create ambiguity for humans because people often do not state obvious physical relations, leading to misunderstandings.
The reliance on unspoken knowledge and the implications of verbs in language can result in misinterpretations of actions and objects, contributing to ambiguity.
